propositions: Five prose upgrades to implement-skill and test-design target major escape classes: parity siblings, config read-but-miswired, contention semantics, gate findings, and residual gaps.
Surface-parity census enumerates five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) with in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason disposition.
Config-effect contrast tests must prove each config key changes behavior through real read path, not merely parse values, catching read-but-miswired scenarios.
Contention triggers route by shape: composed/check-then-act writes to two_clones fixture, write-storm/retry to storm suite, read-integrity to reads-under-sync-contention harness.
Behavioral gate findings require RED test before fix in same change; non-behavioral changes fixed directly with exemption stated to prevent change-detector tests.
Phase-5 residual-gap disposition sweep enumerates all out-of-scope slots and compromises as filed, accepted-with-reason, or fixed.
